enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Speed V: Passive: +25% enhancement bonus to movement speed, +5% enhancement bonus to melee and ranged attack speed.

Feather Falling: This item is engraved with feathers and bestows a powerful magical effect. Whenever the wearer begins to fall from any height, this effect slows the descent dramatically, causing the wearer to fall like a feather.
